description: Unified Amazon listing register: active/inactive/suppressed state and suppression reasons, reconciled from SP-API.

fields.label: Product Type
fields.description: Amazon's product type for this listing, e.g. SHIRT or LUGGAGE. Picked by Search Catalog before publishing an offer, and refreshed from the summary on every sync. Every write to Amazon has to declare it, so a row without one cannot be updated.

fields.label: Brand
fields.description: The brand Amazon holds for this listing. Read from our own `brand` attribute when this seller owns the ASIN's content, and from the catalog entry otherwise. Sync-owned and never pushed: brand is set when the ASIN is created and Amazon does not accept it as an offer update.

fields.label: Product (Item)
fields.description: Optional link to the ERPNext Item this listing represents.

fields.label: Variation
fields.description: Amazon's variation family for this ASIN. Read-only: this connector does not push parentage.

fields.label: Is Variation Parent
fields.description: This ASIN is the family container, not a buyable offer. Parent rows have no price or quantity and are the ones that show a bare SKU when Amazon gives them no title.

fields.label: Parent ASIN
fields.description: The family's parent ASIN. Empty on a standalone listing and on a parent itself. Filter on it to see every SKU in one family.

fields.label: Parent Listing
fields.description: The register row for the parent ASIN, when this seller lists it. Often empty: a variation parent is not buyable, so many sellers have no SKU for it.

fields.label: Variation Theme
fields.description: What the family varies by, e.g. SIZE/COLOR.

fields.label: Condition
fields.options:
new_new
new_open_box
new_oem
used_like_new
used_very_good
used_good
used_acceptable
collectible_like_new
collectible_very_good
collectible_good
collectible_acceptable
refurbished_refurbished

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Maps to the Amazon product_description attribute.

fields.label: Images
fields.description: Flag one row as Main; the rest become additional images (up to 8).

fields.label: Bullet Points
fields.description: Key product features. Amazon allows up to 5 (bullet_point attribute).

fields.label: Catalog Synced At
fields.description: When content and variation parentage were last taken from the Catalog Items API. Empty means this row has never been enriched -- the report-driven reconcile skips rows that already have it, so this is what stops it re-fetching the whole catalog on every run.

fields.label: Last Published At
fields.description: When a publish last submitted this row to Amazon -- a created offer or an accepted update, not a publish that found nothing to send.

fields.label: Last Publish Error
fields.description: Why the last publish attempt failed, cleared by the next one that succeeds. A bulk publish leaves no run document, so this is where a failed row says what happened.

module: Alaiy Os Connector Amazon Sp Api
name: Amazon Product Listing
